disposition_mapping.rationale: Document assembly is reorganised from an analyst-triggered ERP retrieval into a continuous, automated integration step that assembles the document set at invoice validation. The function is unconstrained by design, so the redesign automates it freely while preserving cutoff tagging per KB-03 (reporting-period discipline).

Quantity matching is combined with price/terms matching into a single automated line-matching pass per TWM-R-01. It continues to consume goods receipt note data per TWM-R-03, and its evidential role in establishing cost per KB-09 (inventory cost and evidence) is preserved.

Price and terms matching is combined with quantity matching into TS-02 per TWM-R-02. It continues to consume purchase order data per TWM-R-04, retaining the cost-evidence basis under KB-09 and the determinable-liability basis under KB-11 (payables as financial instruments).

Tolerance evaluation is automated but survives as a discrete classification step per TWM-R-05, still consuming the tolerance policy per TWM-R-06. Automation does not remove the tolerance discipline; it only mechanises its application, consistent with KB-06 (policy consistency) requiring consistent application of an accounting/control policy across periods.

Exception investigation and resolution is preserved substantially unchanged as a human-performed step per TWM-R-10, with AI assistance only augmenting root-cause analysis. This satisfies KB-05 (error correction), which requires that detection-and-correction paths remain available rather than being suppressed by automation.

Release approval survives per TWM-R-07 but is reorganised: clean/tolerance-passed matches straight-through release automatically, while tolerance-override and exception-resolved matches still require explicit supervisor approval. The supervisor approving release (TS-05) is distinct from the analyst performing exception resolution (TS-04), satisfying TWM-R-09, and TS-04 necessarily completes before TS-05 for any given invoice, satisfying the ordering in TWM-R-08. This also keeps liability recognition/derecognition timing determinable per KB-11.

Control reporting is reorganised from periodic batch reporting into continuous logging with a real-time dashboard plus periodic attestation. The function is unconstrained by design, so it is freely modernised while preserving the evidential trail linking matches to reported balances required by KB-02 (fair presentation and faithful representation).

steps.actor: Integration/RPA service (ERP-connected), with AP analyst exception override
steps.description: On invoice validation, an integration layer automatically retrieves the related purchase order and goods receipt note from the ERP and assembles the complete match document set in real time, removing the manual retrieval step. The assembled set is timestamped to the reporting period in which the invoice was received, preserving cutoff discipline.
steps.name: Automated match dataset assembly

steps.actor: ERP/AI matching engine, with AP analyst configuration oversight
steps.description: A matching engine compares invoiced quantities against goods receipt note data and invoiced prices, discounts and tax treatment against purchase order data, line by line, in a single automated pass, producing combined quantity and price/terms variance detail. This establishes the cost evidence chain (purchase price net of discounts, quantity received) underlying inventory and payables measurement.
steps.name: Automated three-way line matching

steps.actor: Matching engine (automated), with AP accountant governance over tolerance policy parameters
steps.description: Quantity and price/terms variances are evaluated automatically against the organisation's tolerance policy, classifying each match as clean, within tolerance, or an exception. Clean and in-tolerance matches are flagged eligible for straight-through release; exceptions are routed to investigation.
steps.name: Automated tolerance evaluation and classification

steps.description: Matches classified as exceptions are investigated by an AP analyst against source documents and vendor correspondence, using AI-assisted root-cause suggestions where available, and resolved as accepted, corrected or rejected, with the resolution evidenced. This step must complete, for a given invoice, before that invoice can proceed to release approval.
steps.name: Exception investigation and resolution

steps.actor: AP supervisor (manual approval for overrides/exceptions; system auto-release for clean/tolerance-passed matches)
steps.description: Clean and in-tolerance matches are released for posting and payment through automated straight-through processing, with the release logged. Matches that required tolerance override or exception resolution are reviewed and explicitly approved by a supervisor distinct from the analyst who performed the exception resolution, before release.
steps.name: Match release approval

steps.description: Match outcomes, tolerance overrides, straight-through releases and exception resolutions are logged continuously to the control record. A real-time dashboard tracks match rates, override frequency and aging exceptions, with periodic attestation produced for control review, preserving the evidential trail linking matches to reported payables.
steps.name: Continuous match control monitoring and reporting
